messages:
sam.platform: FYI we're planning to reroute privnet egress for eu-west to nat-cluster-eu2 on Tue 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. This consolidates NAT IPs but WILL change source IPs seen by downstream KMS proxies and customer audit sinks. Need runbook.
olivia.infra: Thanks — what's the rollback window? how long until GPU warm pools reattach to cache after the switch?
kai.sre: Rollback window 30m. Warm pools may see KMS decrypt failures for initial bootstraps if IP-based allowlists are used. Expect a 2–5min prewarm hit per node group.
sam.platform: Good call. Proposal: 1) Add new nat-cluster IPs to KMS proxy allowlist (temp) 2) Trigger controlled prewarm of GPU pools in small batches 3) Switch egress 4) monitor decrypt & model load errors.
ashley.eng: Can we avoid touching customer KMS allowlists? Some tenants are locked down. Alternative: update egress policy to preserve existing SNAT addresses for warmpool nodes only (bind static SNAT for tags).
olivia.infra: Static SNAT for warmpools is doable but adds cost. Estimated extra NAT-hours ~ 120h for rollout = ~$700 (eu-west). Also adds complexity for autoscaler.
sam.platform: Cost is acceptable if it avoids outages. let's run a small experiment in staging: create warmpool with static SNAT and simulate KMS access.
deploy-bot: scheduled: nat-cluster-eu2-addrs -> apply on staging at 2026-03-25 01:00 UTC (CI job: infra/nat/rollout #3421)
kai.sre: For the prewarm script, use a fallback KMS path: attempt region-local KMS endpoint then fallback to proxy. Add retries + jitter. Example snippet:
```
# prewarm.sh
for i in {1..5}; do
  aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://bootstrap.key --region eu-west-1 && break || sleep $((i*2))
done
```
ashley.eng: Also add an audit-log check: when IPs switch we must ensure our splunk sink maps new src IPs to the right customer org. Otherwise alerts will fire. @olivia.infra can you coordinate with sec-logging?
olivia.infra: On it. I'll open a change ticket to update mapping and bump retention for the transition window +48h. Also will ask sec-logging to whitelist the new NAT IPs for KMS proxy health checks.
sam.platform: Final ask: who owns the canary? need 1 owner for rollout + oncall ping for 30m post-switch.
kai.sre: I'll own canary and watch decrypt/model-load metrics. If errors >0.5% for 10m I'll rollback.
ashley.eng: I'll prepare a runbook section for adding temporary NAT static mapping and cost estimate.
sam.platform: Thanks team. Plan to run staging test and reconvene Tue morning; will post results here. :thumbsup:
